name: DEM scenario B — the overlay tunnel on the path to the app is degraded while the backend stays healthy: the network/path signature wins and confirms
comment: Owner Phase O scenario B (docs/design/research/DEM_OWNER_DESIGN_2026-09-05.md). A synthetic vantage (active_probe) and the branch edge's own control plane (control_plane) are different modality classes with different observers, so the independence gate confirms. tunnel-mtu-blackhole out-ranks the app-experience signature at equal confidence because it explains two clauses (tunnel fault + app symptom) instead of one. No lb/app/cloud telemetry is present at all — 'backend healthy' is expressed by absence, and no application-tier hypothesis confirms.
